# Generated by the Niobium FHE Application Design AI Assistant (FHEanna).
#
# Hardware operation check: one program, hw_ops_check. Needs an installed FIDESlib
# built with haze; by default it is looked up in ../../deps-install/fideslib.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25.2)

# FIDESlib and OpenFHE are built with gcc (libstdc++), and a consumer must use the
# same C++ standard library. The Nix shell exports CXX=clang++ on macOS, so choose
# g++ here unless the caller named a compiler; the check after find_package
# catches a mismatch either way.
if (NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER)
    set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER "g++")
endif ()

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

project(hw_ops_check LANGUAGES CXX)

list(APPEND CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../deps-install/fideslib")
find_package(fideslib REQUIRED CONFIG)

if (NOT FIDESLIB_WITH_HAZE)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "This FIDESlib was built without haze; rebuild it with BACKEND=haze.")
endif ()
if (NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL FIDESLIB_CXX_COMPILER_ID)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "FIDESlib was built with ${FIDESLIB_CXX_COMPILER_ID} but this build uses "
                        "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID}; the two C++ standard libraries do not link. "
                        "Configure with -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++.")
endif ()

set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} ${FIDESLIB_CXX_FLAGS}")

add_executable(hw_ops_check src/hw_ops_check.cpp)
target_link_libraries(hw_ops_check PRIVATE fideslib::fideslib)
